title: I mean… who doesn’t love a free gift???  Plus they are very fun to us...
transcript: Pro tip for anyone going to see cats: the Jellicle Ball on Broadway if you would like a fan, be sure to get there early because if you don't know, they are actually giving out fans to the first like hundred people in line. They come in a variety of colours, so I happened to get yellow, my friend Liz got green, and there is no one collecting them after the show, so they are yours to keep. I actually did not know this was happening, but we happened to get there around 6:30 for a 7 PM show and they were handing out the last of their stock, so we were able to get one, but just barely. Now if you miss them, they do actually sell a fan at their merch stand. It's a little bit nicer quality and has the cat's branding on it, but if you wanna get one of the free ones I would say get there no less than 30 minutes early.
